name: manual_df8c0b
claim: Order a batch of work by what each step needs: run independent reads first and in parallel (research, and diagnosing why a pull request conflicts); let research feed the docs and code, and the docs and memory feed the commits; make one push per repository the last step, with every ref in one command, because review replies and pull-request-body follow-ups cite pushed SHAs and so follow it. Restack stacked branches in order before that push.

decisions.notes: The operator asked for a remediation done in dependency order after an earlier batch interleaved research, edits and pushes. The order that worked was parallel model-release research and conflict diagnosis, then docs and memory, then logical commits, then a single push per repository, with replies and body follow-ups citing the pushed SHAs.
